Repository source registry and evidence-use boundaries.

Official Beijing profile reports 3.122 million Haidian permanent residents at the end of 2024; used only as a regional population-scale coverage reference, not as workforce counts, OD, mode shares or local performance.
Official open-call scope, key areas and deliverable context.

Provisional boundary from the public task wording; not an official redline.
Three provisional key-area polygons from public task wording; not official polygons.
Background-only mapped transport screening; not capacity, right-of-way or accessibility proof.

sources.usage: Beijing transport objectives: door-to-door mobility, integrated rail/bus/walk/cycle, public-transport priority and smart transport; not a local baseline.
2026–2027 Haidian road-parking management service tender: order, guidance, patrol, equipment, exception handling, backend and complaint response; not a local inventory for this package.
Haidian planning material on transit hubs, ground-floor interfaces, bicycle interchange, emergency routes and traffic impact review; not a Jing-Zhang approved plan.
Haidian slow-mobility improvement project and traffic-diversion procurement context; not a measured project outcome.
City walking/cycling priority and network-continuity policy context.
Beijing walking/cycling planning and design standard; project dimensions remain for professional review.
Accessibility, connected routes, consultation, information access and repair responsibility.
Longitudinal employer travel-demand-management evidence; methods and cautions only, not local effect sizes.
Employer TDM plan guide covering transit, carpool, bicycle, variable hours, telework and monitoring.
Public/private curbspace management research; supports time windows, responsibility and conflict logging, not local counts.
Shared autonomous vehicle and transit competition research; used to bound feeder scenarios, not to forecast Haidian traffic.
Shared autonomous vehicles in microtransit research; method context only, not a deployment approval.
Shared-mobility transition policy context for inclusion and public management; no local outcome claim.
Human-centred AI, explainability, participation and accountability context.
Mobility demand/offer matrix method across modes and operators; variables only, not local measurements.
Open activity/agent-based multimodal workflow; requires comparison against observed mode share, road volume, travel time and distance, not a Haidian baseline.
Activity-scheduling adaptation method reference for a bounded enterprise-window sensitivity; no imported coefficients, local effect size or employee-level inference.
Grouped job-accessibility inequality method; supports distributional checks and does not transfer São Paulo results to Haidian.
Comparative workplace charging demand/supply study; used to require joint demand and supply survey, not as Beijing baseline.
Beijing low-altitude economy action-plan context for coordinated facilities and air-ground systems; not a local permission or route.
Civil aviation unmanned-aircraft flight-management regulation; used as safety, operation, emergency and responsibility gate, not as project approval.
SUMO official documentation for multimodal permissions, pedestrians and bicycles; method base only, requiring local calibration.
Physical/virtual multimodal traffic simulation method reference; not a local performance result.
Urban air mobility and ground-mode integration method reference; not a Beijing project permit or local demand baseline.
Vertiport connection to public transit and walking/bus infrastructure method reference; not a local siting decision.
Multimodal public-transport and bicycle efficiency/equity method reference; no local outcome is imported.
Joint mode and time-of-day choice method including arrival flexibility, reliability and public-transport crowding; no local coefficients are imported.
Departure-time choice equilibrium for schedule-based public transport with hard capacity constraints; method reference only.

Exact system-optimum transit demand-management method with hard capacity and competing time-space flows; supports separating nominal efficiency ranking from a declared robustness stress screen without importing local coefficients.
Evidence on flexible work schedules and commute departure-time choice; regional effect sizes are not transferred to Haidian.
Transit-oriented conditional vertiport siting method; supports ground-first integration logic and does not establish a local route, site or permit.
Multimodal resilience method with metro, passenger-flow, constrained vertiport and cascading-failure scenarios; method reference only, not a local resilience result.
Agent-based transport-equity and level-of-service trade-off method; supports grouped access checks and does not transfer Berlin outputs to Haidian.
MATSim official framework reference for large-scale agent-based, activity-based and multimodal transport simulation; method inspiration only, not a Haidian calibration or performance result.
MATSim book reference for population-scale activity-based demand, network interaction and iterative transport simulation; no coefficients or local outputs are imported.
Activity-pattern, tour, time-of-day, destination and mode-choice model reference; supports separating activity chains from observed local demand, without transferring estimates.
Accessibility-equity and demand-responsive feeder allocation method reference; motivates a future low-density/edge feeder candidate, not a local Haidian service claim.

Schedule-based transit assignment with explicit vehicle capacity, departure-time/stop/run choice, residual capacity and within-day queue formation; method boundary only, with no local coefficients or Haidian performance imported.

Capacity-feasible dynamic public-transport assignment with crowded vehicles, denied boarding, dwell-delay and passenger adaptation; used to motivate the time-slice operations screen, not to transfer parameters or claim local validation.
Integrated multiscale agent- and activity-based multimodal simulation framework; method context for separating population-scale replay from local calibration and operational inputs.

Public-transport satisfaction study linking reliability, waiting and crowding to user evaluation; used to justify separate reliability and crowding terms, without importing coefficients or claiming local satisfaction.
Passenger-kilometre definition and broad mode-comparison context for the relative resource-pressure screen; no EU average is transferred as a Haidian energy or emissions factor.

Method-only reference for expressing passenger-mode energy intensity on a passenger-mile basis and normalizing a relative screen; national averages are not local coefficients, and shuttle factors remain unknown until local fleet evidence exists.

Sufficiency-based accessibility method reference; supports showing whether groups meet an explicit time budget rather than relying only on group averages. No external threshold or local result is imported.

Transit accessibility method reference covering schedule uncertainty, congestion, real-time information and alternative paths. It motivates a synthetic time-budget readout and supplies no Haidian coefficient or field result.

Weekly activity-based modelling reference for activity patterns, timing, duration, destination and mode choice across mandatory and discretionary activities. Used to justify a seven-day aggregate design screen; no coefficients, survey shares or local effects are imported.

MIT SimMobility project overview for activity-based, multimodal and multiscale simulation spanning private traffic, transit, pedestrians and freight. Used as method context only; Singapore or other case-study calibration is not transferred to Haidian.

Integrated agent-based transit framework reference covering activity generation, timing, mode choice, routing, transit, traffic, pedestrian and freight interactions. Used to motivate explicit cross-mode interactions and a 24-hour replay boundary; no local coefficients or case-study outcomes are imported.
